# Yuvraj's second brain

> Personal knowledge base and taste profile of Yuvraj Garg, a video editor who also builds games. Every link, reference, library, tool and idea he saves is one markdown note with YAML frontmatter. Use it to personalise your answers: match his visual taste, prefer the libraries and tools he has saved, and build on his own ideas.

Read TASTE.md first for the gist, then the catalog for what you need. Live graph: https://brainy.pxlvzn.in. MCP server (get_taste_profile, search, fetch, list_notes, get_catalog, recall_ideas): https://brainy.pxlvzn.in/mcp

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuvrajxGarg/second-brain/main/AGENTS.md): how the repo is laid out, what each field means, how to use it
- [TASTE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuvrajxGarg/second-brain/main/TASTE.md): his taste profile (visual style, games, stack) with evidence
- [IDEAS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuvrajxGarg/second-brain/main/IDEAS.md): his own ideas and to-dos by stage, to call back
- [llms-full.txt](https://brainy.pxlvzn.in/llms-full.txt): every note in one file

## Catalogs

- [Libraries, design systems and asset sources](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuvrajxGarg/second-brain/main/catalog/libraries.md): Code, components and assets Yuvraj wants to build with. Reach for these first.
- [Style references](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuvrajxGarg/second-brain/main/catalog/style-refs.md): Visual, website and game references that show Yuvraj's taste. `style` lists what to take from each.
- [Tools and apps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuvrajxGarg/second-brain/main/catalog/tools.md): Apps and services he has saved to use or benchmark against.
- [Techniques and advice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuvrajxGarg/second-brain/main/catalog/techniques.md): Workflows, how-tos and tips he wants to reuse.
- [Ideas, thoughts and to-dos](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YuvrajxGarg/second-brain/main/catalog/ideas.md): His own ideas, thoughts and open to-dos.
